
# Sadaqah Code

Sadaqah Code is an Islamic open-source initiative building free, accessible digital tools for Muslims through open-source collaboration. Its work is guided by Islamic values, privacy, respect, and lasting benefit.

## About

- [Official Website](https://sadaqahcode.com/)
- [Maintained by FlagoDNA](https://flagodna.com/)
- [GitHub Organization](https://github.com/SadaqahCode)
- [Community Discord](https://discord.gg/u5s8cJFVuA)
- [Contact](mailto:sadaqahcode@proton.me)

## Principles

- Open-source software that people can study, use, modify, and contribute to under each project's license.
- Privacy and data minimization; no advertising or sale of user data.
- Care and respect in handling Quran, Sunnah, and Islamic content.
- Free and accessible tools without unnecessary barriers.
- Technology that respects people's time, attention, and dignity.
- Community knowledge, feedback, and collaboration.
